user.title: Connect Skylight lists
user.description:
1. [Open Skylight sign-in]({auth_url}) in a new tab.
2. Sign in to Skylight in your browser.
3. Copy the value of `code` from the resulting URL (or paste the entire URL) below. Codes expire quickly.

This unofficial integration requests Skylight's broad `everything` scope even though it only uses lists.

pick_frame.title: Choose Skylight frame
pick_frame.description: Choose the household/frame with the lists to sync.
